questions.question: What makes the text editor tool different from custom tools built earlier in the course?
options: Claude has access to its JSON schema by default, unlike custom tools which require you to write the schema yourself
It requires no server-side code at all to function
It can only be used with extended thinking enabled
It does not support undo operations

questions.question: For the text editor tool, which half does Anthropic provide, and which half is still the developer's responsibility?
options: Anthropic provides the JSON schema; the developer must still implement the function that performs the real file operations
Anthropic provides the full implementation; the developer only needs to register the schema
Anthropic provides neither half; both must be written from scratch
Anthropic provides both halves, requiring no developer work at all

questions.question: Why doesn't the Claude API ship an SDK with a ready-made, per-OS text editor tool implementation the way it bundles the schema?
options: File I/O is inherently environment/permission-specific in a way that resists a safe universal default
Text editor functionality is considered deprecated
It would violate the tool's JSON schema format
Only the web search tool is allowed to have a bundled implementation
